subject: Box plot--using the same scale for y-axis for two boxplots

messages.subject: Box plot--using the same scale for y-axis for two boxplots
parts: My two box plots are to be places next to each other for comparison. Both are nearly within the same range, where the y-axis range for one is 120-220 and the other 100-225. How can I have both y-axes have the exact same range? Thank you.

messages.author: ac2d2e4dc0e3cb16
messages.subject: Re: Box plot--using the same scale for y-axis for two boxplots
parts:
There are several ways of doing this: groups, facets of by specifying the ylimits:

a1<-data.frame(v1=rnorm(100,1), v2=factor(1))
a2<-data.frame(v1=rnorm(100,2), v2=factor(2))

library(ggplot2)

ggplot(rbind(a1,a2))+aes(x=v2,y=v1,group=v2)+geom_boxplot()
ggplot(rbind(a1,a2))+aes(x=v2,y=v1)+facet_grid( ~v2)+geom_boxplot()

ggplot(a1)+aes(x=1,y=v1)+geom_boxplot()+scale_y_continuous(limits=c(-4,4))
ggplot(a2)+aes(x=1,y=v1)+geom_boxplot()+scale_y_continuous(limits=c(-4,4))
